summary: First-pass testing of SentinelMar backend + frontend. Built comprehensive pytest suite (20 tests) covering stats, cases, candidates, correlate (sync/async/params override), review flows (confirm success + 3x 400 error cases), evidence, geojson (backprojected only on non-degraded), AIS ingest (dupe/flags/invalid lat), spill validation (bowtie/Point/unknown-flag/unknown-scene), scene create+duplicate+detect, alerts ack, jobs list/404, config defaults, audit, case 404. All 20 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend Playwright verified Dashboard KPIs+rows+filters+alerts ack, CaseDetail (case-number, attribution, tabs review/evidence/log, candidates+factor cards, disclaimer, correlate params toggle, export/AIS toggle), Ingest (register scene, mock detect->navigate to case, create spill->navigate, AIS ingest with duplicate/flagged counts), and Jobs page (26 job rows + 34 alerts).

minor.issue: Documented behavior: rejects invalid geometry with 400 (correctly). Note: Pydantic-level required-field errors return 422 which is normal FastAPI behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="case-map" is set on <MapContainer> but react-leaflet does NOT forward arbitrary DOM attrs to the underlying container div, so [data-testid=case-map] cannot be located via automation. The .leaflet-container div renders correctly. Recommend wrapping <MapContainer> in a <div data-testid="case-map"> or attaching via whenCreated ref.

React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — the .map() returns bare React fragments <>...</> containing two <tr> siblings; fragments cannot carry a key. Use <React.Fragment key={j.id}> instead.
Hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option>. Some wrapper (likely a badge/StatusBadge) is nested inside an <option> element which is not valid HTML.

action_items: Fix CaseMap data-testid forwarding (wrap MapContainer in a div with data-testid="case-map")
Fix React fragment key warning in Jobs.jsx (use React.Fragment with key)
Fix invalid HTML in ReviewForm review-vessel-select options (no <span> inside <option>)
critical_code_review_comments: CaseDetail attribution_status for SPL-20260610-001 permanently becomes 'analyst_confirmed' once the confirm test runs; documented in review_request. Test suite is idempotent (uses in/2xx range) and orders error-cases before confirm.

Correlate endpoint returns HTTP 202 for both sync:true and sync:false; only body.status distinguishes (succeeded vs queued). Consider returning 200 for synchronous completions to better follow HTTP semantics.
Backend jobs collection accumulates without bound; consider a retention/TTL policy or paginated /api/jobs endpoint.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from responses across all routers.
Env vars sourced from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and MONGO_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs found.
test_credentials: None — open API, no auth (per problem statement)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created additional cases/scenes/AIS positions (TEST_ prefix where possible). SPL-20260610-001 permanently transitioned to analyst_confirmed by test_review_confirm_success. Total 26 jobs and many alerts accumulated during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPL-20260610-001 is now analyst_confirmed (irreversible per design). Candidate count on -001 is 7 (not 5) because AIS test-ingest positions in the same corridor added 2 TEST vessels. Run tests are idempotent thereafter. case-map testid issue may block map-related UI tests until fixed.
